stem: A 17-year-old presents shortly after using cannabis. Which additional feature would support acute cannabis effects rather than cannabis withdrawal?
explanation: Conjunctival injection is the best feature of acute cannabis use here. It is a typical acute effect, whereas vivid dreams, depressed mood, weight loss, and anorexia are more consistent with cannabis withdrawal.

citations.title: Louisa Leone MD3 2025 - Child and Adolescent Health - Study Notes.pdf

optionExplanations.A: Incorrect because vivid dreams are more characteristic of cannabis withdrawal.
optionExplanations.B: Incorrect because depressed mood is a withdrawal feature rather than a typical acute effect.
optionExplanations.C: Correct because conjunctival injection is a recognised acute effect of cannabis use.
optionExplanations.D: Incorrect because weight loss is more consistent with cannabis withdrawal.
optionExplanations.E: Incorrect because anorexia is more consistent with cannabis withdrawal.
